verification.method: scripts/verify/latvia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population, rank, share, growth, density, land area; below the 1950 level (second-farthest of 1 million+ countries after Bulgaria)
Peak 1989, about 69% left (second-largest fall from own peak after Moldova); falls every year 1990–2022 (33 years), rise 2023
Net departures every year 1989–2021, largest 1992; arrivals 2022–2023; deaths above births every year 1992–2100
Sex ratio fifth-lowest of 1 million+ countries; 2050 and 2100 projections
title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) — 80 of 80 checks match
